facts.business: DISA India Limited manufactures foundry machinery and equipment, including DISA, Wheelabrator, and Simpson product lines, and provides aftermarket services for the foundry industry.

capacity_or_capex.item: Greenfield production facility near existing plant in Tumkur
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Completed; expected to support growth over next decade

capacity_or_capex.item: Additions to property, plant and equipment

guidance_or_targets.statement: India's GDP growth for FY 2026-27 is projected at 6.3%-6.5%
Short-term demand for castings expected to grow steadily at 3-4% annually

key_risks: Global economic slowdown due to conflicts in Europe and West Asia
Liquidity constraints in capital goods sector
Adoption of cleaner and sustainable technologies
Shortage of skilled labour and high attrition
Long gestation periods for greenfield projects
Strong competition from new entrants and diversified investments
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 and details have been disclosed in the notes to the financial statements.
